description.blurb: S/2004 S 24 is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 24 is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1294.25 days, at an inclination of 35.5° to the ecliptic, in a prograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.085.
